# Panel image index (built 2026-10-19) — part 1 of 1


# Panel image index (built 2026-10-19)

Every row is one saved image. "Feat / quote" is the respect-thread or blog caption next to the image (poster wording, not quote text) unless it says quote. Source is only what the thread, RT tag, or issue post states; nothing is inferred. "issue unknown" means the thread does not say which comic or issue. Local paths are relative to [local path] Animated GIFs are mostly game or film footage posted in the threads, not comic panels.

Match column: where the panel reference was added in the notes (file:line) and why; "appendix" means it is listed in the auto-added panel section at the end of that notes file. Invincible and Secret Wars (1984) panels were found online; they are marked "found online, matched by description" unless the source identifies the issue.

## Contents

- **Star Wars (Legends unless noted)**: Abeloth (13), Count Dooku (135), Exar Kun (129), Karness Muur (3), Darth Krayt (129), Kreia / Darth Traya (55), Luke Skywalker (2), Mace Windu (95), Darth Malgus (9), Darth Maul (62), Meetra Surik (Jedi Exile) (18), Obi-Wan Kenobi (1), Darth Plagueis (4), Revan (53), Darth Sidious (220), Darth Sion (25), Darth Vader (180), Vitiate / Tenebrae / Valkorion (162), Yoda (35)
- **Secret Wars (1984)**: Beyonder (73), Captain America (8), Captain Marvel (1), Colossus (8), Doctor Doom (149), Enchantress (2), Galactus (21), Hulk (12), Human Torch (2), Kang (1), Klaw (1), Magneto (5), Molecule Man (36), Reed Richards (2), Secret Wars (1984) - other / ensemble (29), Spider Man (16), Thing (5), Thor (5), Ultron (2), Volcana (1), Wasp (11), Wolverine (3), Xavier (3)
